description: Japanese Restaurant Sakura Deli – BBQ is a Restaurant which serves customers the most japanese dishes in Lao Cai. You can also easily enjoy the famous dishes of cherry blossom country at Sakura Deli – BBQ at 082 Hop Thanh Street, Pho Moi Ward, Lao Cai city. In Japanese style, Sakura Deli – BBQ has VIP rooms and harmonious space for cozy atmosphere which brings customers cozy and comfortable feeling. Here you can celebrate parties in occasions of birthday, anniversary, or important invitation. Sakura Deli Lao Cai is a ideal and recommended Restaurant for Tourists, especially for stopovers who wait for a train or are on a business trip, because our Restaurant is so near the Lao Cai International Station. Sakura Deli Lao Cai serve not only the traditional dishes such as Sashimi, Sushi, Tempura, Hotpot, BBQ, we also serve especially dishes such as Kobe Beef, Fuji Beef, snow fish, abalone which are imported from Japan. The food is always fresh, ensures excellent quality, not only attractive and delicious but also good for health, the water is filtered through purified water filtration systems by European standards. With a modern and ancient combination style, we hope to bring you to a beautiful place by light, by the meticulous and metaphorical images of the Japanese culture or by blocks expressing space and promoting the natural effect of light. Japanese architecture is knowed as the architecture of wood and natural materials, moreover the modern equipment such as air conditions, modern designed tables, that make customers relaxed and comfortable. “On the first floor, you can directly experience how to make sushi, sashimi by sitting on the sushi bar which is designed by a combination of traditional beauty and elegant modern style. Seeking some fragrant passionately sake and feeling relaxed as you are in a sushi restaurant in japan.” – Customer’ comment. The VIP room at the second floor are suitable for the privat, introverted space. Quiet space but Zen, open mind, is an ideal place for you to enjoy delicious food and discuss work. If you want to enjoy Japanese delicious food in a beautiful and japanese designed space in Lao Cai, city frontier of the country, you should visit Sakura Deli – BBQ Lao Cai.
